title: Go Home & Go Out
situation: Evening and weekend plans with family.
objective: Use go home and go out to talk about plans after work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After work, I usually go home.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Sometimes I go out with my family to have dinner.
dialogue.indonesian: Terkadang saya pergi bersama keluarga untuk makan malam.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: On weekends, we like to go to different places.
dialogue.indonesian: Pada akhir pekan, kami suka pergi ke berbagai tempat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If we have enough time, we go to a coffee shop and enjoy our time together.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika punya cukup waktu, kami pergi ke kedai kopi dan menikmati waktu bersama.

learningNotes: go home tidak memakai to: go home, bukan go to home.
go out berarti keluar untuk bersenang-senang atau bertemu orang.
on weekends memakai on untuk kebiasaan yang berulang di akhir pekan.
